page.overview:
Who is Boco?

Boco, or Boko is a recurring chocobo name in the Final Fantasy series. Boco often plays an important role as one of the main characters' chocobo, or otherwise as a notable chocobo in the game.

Known as Boko in later versions, he is the protagonist Bartz Klauser's chocobo and faithful friend. Boko has a brief appearance at the beginning of Bartz's world when he helps Bartz rescue Lenna and Galuf, but is injured off-camera in the process, and is taken care of by an NPC in the Pirates' Hideout.

In the merged world he has recovered, and helps the party cross a number of rivers on their way to what they discover to be Ghido's Cave. When the party gains control of the airship, the player can ride Boko to complete a circular tour of the world, in order to prove to an NPC in Phantom Village to be worthy recipients of a Mirage Vest. It is also possible to take a detour to the top of Istory Falls to find and/or recharge the Magic Lamp item.

A set of three chocobos (presumably Boko's grown-up offsprings that he had with Koko after meeting her in the merged world) appear during the ending cutscene to transport Bartz, Lenna and Faris around the world.
